title: Food-Waste Reduction Tracker
dataSources: Carbon estimates (`carbon:estimate`), recycling weight (`recycling:weight`), food waste (`foodwaste:log`), repairs (`repair:event`).
app: Sustainability telemetry — carbon-footprint apps, home recycling scales, food-waste logs, and repair / reuse journals — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=foodwaste:log
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(kg) as wasted, sum(est_value) as value by _time
| eventstats avg(wasted) as base
| eval improving=if(wasted<base,1,0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how much food you throw away each week and what it cost, turning waste into a number you can cut.
value: Households bin a shocking amount of food; measuring it in weight and money is the strongest motivator to reduce it.
implementation: Ingest food-waste logs into `index=personal`; trend weekly waste and its value.
visualization: Column chart of weekly food waste with cost overlay.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how much food you throw away each week and what it cost, helping you waste less.
